rows.en: By the way, you don't seem to be a Kamen Rider or an MS (mobile suit)...
Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet.
I'm Zero... Ultraman Zero.
I'm an Ultra Warrior, a member of the Space Garrison who protects peace in the universe.
Gotcha. So in Zero's world, the Ultra Warriors are the heroes.
Being called a "hero" to my face is kinda embarrassing, but yeah, that's about the size of it.
I'm Kamen Rider OOO. I want to help as many people as I possibly can.
Nice to meet you, Zero!!
Good to meet you too.
I'm Kamen Rider W (Double), a hard-boiled private eye who protects the peace of Fuuto.
Fuuto and space are on different scales, but we share the same love of peace.
I'm counting on you.
I don't really get what's going on, but... well, nice to meet you anyway!
I'm Nu Gundam. I commanded a combat unit attached to Londo Bell...
...and fought the Zeon remnants.
Put simply, Zero, I'm just like you: a warrior fighting for peace in the universe.
I see. You seem like someone I can rely on.
By the way... what exactly is this place we're in right now?
This place seems rebuilt from parts of the many facilities and bases pulled in from each world.
But we don't know anything beyond that.
And is there a way back to our own worlds?
Well... so far, we have no idea at all.
I see. I'd hoped I could contact the other Ultra Warriors, but from the sound of it...
Yeah. We've got no way to contact our original worlds, either...
So we're planning to go investigate.
Investigate?
Further in, there's a facility called the "Gate Port". Seems it leads to "somewhere else".
If we look into it, we might learn something.
I see... My comrades might be out there too.
Let's look for them together. There's a buddy of mine I got separated from, too.
The guy who's "just a hand"!!
Just a hand?
Yeah... It's a long story, but he's only a hand right now.
Ah, I mean, he looks weird, but he's a good guy at heart. Really!
All kinds of worlds have ended up in one place. Whoever shows up, it won't surprise me.
W's right. As fellow heroes, I'm sure we can understand each other.
You're right! Right now, what matters is that we join forces.
All right, I'm gonna do everything I can!!
Yeah. I also want to know what's going on back in our original worlds.
And to do that, we have to unravel the mysteries of this world.
Yes.
Good. Then before we start investigating, let's settle one thing.
Fortunately, there are no threatening "enemies" in this place.
What's more, part of the facility still works. It looks like we can even recover our strength here.
There's also equipment we could use if we repair it.
So I'm thinking we use this place as our "base".
Agreed!
I've got no objections.
I'll follow your lead.
Good! Then everyone, get yourselves ready for the investigation.
Once you're ready, gather at the "Gate Port".
Roger!!
Right!
All riiight!!
Once the three, Nu Gundam, Kamen Rider OOO and Ultraman Zero, had finished preparing,
(Where am I...?)
(Why am I in a place like this...?)
(...Anyway, I'll try walking around.)
(But what is this...? Just walking feels like it's draining my strength...)
(This is no ordinary space...)
Uwah!!
(What...!? What was that tremor!!)
Something's here!!
What...!? Who are you guys...
The two mysterious beings gave no answer and suddenly attacked!
Kikikikiki!!
Gwah...!!
Wah!! What the hell... do you think you're doing!!
Kikiiiiih!!
It dodged...!? Damn it!!
Kikikikiki!!
Uwaaaaah...!!
...What's with these guys? My attacks are...
At that moment!! A single flash of light shot out from out of nowhere!!

notes.note: Table 0998 (Base) is an alternate/prototype prologue: its event script Event/Base/Top/0998.bla only plays the tutorial prompt rows (0.1-0.3), so rows 0.5-0.111 have no script and no speaker data. Speakers inferred from wording and from the parallel prologue MainEventMess01 (story_001/002): Nu Gundam (kimi, calm commander) 0.55/0.68-0.70/0.73-0.74/0.96-0.101/0.105-0.106; Zero 0.56-0.58/0.60/0.63/0.67/0.71-0.72/0.75/0.77/0.80/0.83; OOO 0.61-0.62/0.84/0.87-0.88; W (Shotaro) 0.59/0.64-0.66/0.85/0.89. 'MS (mobile suit)' keeps the source's reading gloss, as earlier slices did.
Same as MainEventMess01#0.56 except the source now quotes 'hero'; quotes added to the reused English.
Source puts Fuuto first, then space (reverse of MainEventMess01#0.61); English follows the new order.
Direction: W asking Zero for cooperation -> 'I'm counting on you.' (reused).
Reading gloss on Nu dropped (English already spells it). Sentence continues into 0.69; cut at the same point as the story_001 version.
Speaker unrecovered (Nu Gundam or OOO); subject 'we' = the group already in the base.
Speaker unrecovered (W or OOO, plain explanatory ending); 'we' = the heroes already in the base.
'Gate Port' = UI glossary term for the hub facility; this version replaces the story_001 'gate'/'Hangar' wording. Both quoted terms keep the source's quotation marks.
Speaker inferred as W (0.90 says 'W's right' about 0.89). OOO's partner = Ankh (male) -> 'he' in 0.87/0.88.
Speaker uncertain (Zero or W); line written speaker-neutral.
Source says 'the original world' with no possessor; 'our original worlds' as in 0.78, since each hero comes from a different world. Speaker uncertain (likely W or Zero).
Bare polite 'hai' -> 'Yes.' Likely OOO (polite) answering Nu Gundam.
'Only partly' folded into 'part of the facility still works'; HP recovery -> 'recover our strength'.

0.107-0.109 are a chorus of replies; 'Roger!!'/'Right!' reused from MainEventMess01#0.103-0.104. 0.109 reuses the established 'All riiight!!' for the same Japanese; speaker here is probably Zero (brash), not Momotaros.
Last entry of the table ends mid-sentence with a comma (no continuation exists in the table); English kept unfinished with the trailing comma.

Script Event/Base/Top/0999.bla: TextIdOffset 0, MessWinSet(TextIdOffset+n) plays entry n+1 (calibrated: +0 -> 0.1 with Zero's portrait loaded; +6/+7 -> 0.7/0.8 under CHARA_NAME 15 = Zero). Rows 0.11+ are not played by this script; they duplicate Dungeon/NC01 MainEventMess0989 (story_178), whose English is reused. 0.1-0.19 are all Zero (thoughts in parentheses as in the source).
'...' rows 0.37/0.38/0.43/0.46/0.49 are the two silent attackers (a Hi-Zack and a kaijin, per story_194 / 0989); the 'Kikiki' cries reuse the established Bat Man roar.
Opening differs from 0989 (no leading 'to,'), so 'At that moment!!' instead of 'Just then!!'; rest reused.

report: 80/80 rows. Table 0998 (Base) prologue has no event script for rows 0.5+; all speakers inferred from wording and the parallel MainEventMess01 prologue. 49 rows reused verbatim from story_001/002/178 (0989 scene); rows whose source changed were adapted. Uncertain speakers: 0.76, 0.79, 0.91, 0.93, 0.109. 0.111 ends mid-sentence in the source (kept unfinished). No new names; Londo Bell/Zeon/Gate Port as established.
